library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Register an in-memory H2 DataSource bean (e.g. jdbc:h2:mem:<unique-name>;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1) in the test's application context so LiquibaseDataSourceCondition is satisfied and LiquibaseAutoConfiguration actually creates/runs a SpringLiquibase bean. Provide a minimal changelog on the test classpath (default path is db/changelog/db.changelog-master.yaml, or set spring.liquibase.change-log to a test resource) since SpringLiquibase.afterPropertiesSet() fails fast if no changelog is resolvable. No Docker image or system property is required — the actuate LiquibaseEndpoint class additionally needs spring-boot-actuator on the classpath, but that's optional bonus coverage, not required for the core autoconfiguration path.
risks: The actuate endpoint (LiquibaseEndpoint) and the docker-compose/testcontainers connection-details factories in this jar are only reachable if spring-boot-actuator / spring-boot-docker-compose / spring-boot-testcontainers are also on the test classpath; those were left out of deterministic_setup since they're optional enrichments, not blockers for core coverage — local verification may still reveal additional gaps.

H2 version 2.4.240 was chosen by matching the most recent precedent in the repo rather than confirming compatibility against Spring Boot 4.1.0 and liquibase-core 5.0.3 directly; Gradle/native-image verification should confirm no incompatibility.
